en: The Hymn to the Eight Mothers: Om, salutations to the eight mothers of Śrī Vighneśvara!
O Vighneśvara, great hero, for the increase of success in the form of spiritual attainment!
I bow down to the god Gaṇeśa for the destruction of obstacles. || 1 ||
In the east, the goddess Brahmāṇī is stationed, mounted upon a swan;
O Goddess Śrī Brahmāṇī, whose radiance is yellow in hue, salutations be unto you! (2)
To the south is Śrīvārāhī, seated upon a buffalo throne;
she is red in color and holds a goad in her hand. O Śrīvārāhī, salutations be to you! (3)
In the west, the goddess Indrāṇī stands mounted upon an elephant; she has the luster of saffron and holds a thunderbolt in her hand. O Śrī Indrāṇī, salutations be to you! (4)
In the north resides the goddess Māheśvarī, mounted upon a bull;
O goddess Māheśvarī, whose radiance is white in color, salutations be unto you! (5)
In the southeast is Bālakaumārī, who fills the space with the luster of a peacock;
she is red in color and holds a spear in her hand—O Śrīkaumāri, salutations be to you! (6)
In the southwest is the goddess Vaiṣṇavī, dark-complexioned and seated upon Garuḍa;
O Goddess Nārāyaṇī, bearer of the conch and the discus, salutations be unto you! 7.
In the northwest resides the goddess Cāmuṇḍā, seated upon a lion;
bearing the form of the letter Ka and holding a sword in her hand, I bow to her. 8.
In the northeast is the goddess Caṇḍikā, smoke-colored and blazing;
O Goddess Mahālakṣmī, who holds a knife and a severed head, salutations be to you! 9.
I bow to the goddesses who reside upon the eight seats, who dwell within the eight trees,
who are joined with the eight Bhairavas, and who are the eight Mothers.
To Sūrya, Soma, the son of Mahī (Maṅgala), Budha, and the preceptors of the gods and asuras (Jupiter and Venus),
to Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu, and to Yama— salutations again and again.
The Śrī Aṣṭamātṛkāstotra is completed.
